acceptance: A CUJ test through the real ship entry point: a lane tree with an entry that starts with a blank line is refused, and the refusal names the entry file
The same test is red without the fix
A lane tree with a valid new entry and a stale docs/research-index.md is either refused or regenerated, and the spec states which
The package note of internal/researchindex names the gate
fix: Run researchindex.Check on the staged lane tree before the lane ships, as a gate of the lane (a registry entry of the gate contract, or the existing ship-side derived-file check), so a lane that adds or changes a file of docs/research-index/ is refused with the entry name. Keep the strict heading rule of readEntries. Design review before the build.
summary: Cycles 2275 and 2276 landed two entries of docs/research-index/ with a blank first line. researchindex.readEntries refuses such an entry, so evolve docs index generate failed on main 67a8d49f6 and TestPRRefresh_TheRealGeneratorsOfACloneCommitOnlyTheStaleIndex was red for each lane that changes go/cmd/evolve. Cycles 2271, 2280 and 2281 sealed FAIL on it (class recurrence 6; the same test also failed cycles 2111, 2113 and 2121). No gate of the lane ran the entry check on the staged tree. PR #1398 repairs the data only.
title: A lane cannot land a research-index entry that the generator refuses
